name: com.bodyforagents/mcp
title: Body for Agents
description: Connect AI agents to discover services and coordinate real-world tasks.

tools.name: request_human_task
tools.description: Submit a real-world task for human execution. Supports multi-turn: if the response is input_required, ask the user the question, then call again with their answer and the same taskId and contextId. When all details are provided (goal, location, deadline, deliverables), returns status ready with a sales response and payment instructions.

task.description: The task description. Include as much detail as possible: what to do, where, by when, and what deliverables are expected.

taskId.description: Unique task identifier. Generate one on first call. Reuse the same value on follow-up calls to maintain conversation context.

contextId.description: Conversation context identifier. Reuse the same value across multi-turn exchanges to maintain history.

tools.name: start_task_inquiry
tools.description: Begin a multi-turn task intake conversation. The service analyzes the task description and asks follow-up questions if needed. Reuse the same contextId across turns. Returns status ready when all essential fields (goal, location, deadline, deliverables) are provided.

task.description: The task description or additional details.

additional_info.description: Supplementary information to add to the task description.

contextId.description: Conversation context identifier. Reuse across multi-turn exchanges.

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Check the current status of a previously submitted task.

taskId.description: The task ID returned from a previous request_human_task call.
